description: From modest beginnings, Samuel L. Jackson has evolved into a Hollywood heavyweight, symbolizing resilience and dedication. description: The National Testing Agency is expected to release the Re-NEET 2026 OMR response sheets, final answer key and result soon on the official website. description: A Delta flight landing in Chicago on July 4th reported a startling 'big bang' as it was apparently struck by fireworks at a low altitude. description: The Nato Ankara Summit marks a pivotal moment as the alliance shifts gears from US dependency towards a robust, European-led defence coalition. Motivated by an unpredictable America and an assertive Russia, Nato is emphasizing agility, industrial capabilities, and strong partnerships. description: A Delhi high court ruling clarifies that families cannot claim compensation from a car owner's personal accident insurance via the Motor Accident Claims Tribunal (MACT) if the borrower dies driving the vehicle. Such claims, particularly under Section 166 of the Motor Vehicles Act requiring proof of negligence, are deemed contractual and fall outside MACT's jurisdiction, necessitating pursuit in consumer forums or civil courts.

England now advance to face Norway in the quarter-finals, while Mexico's Round of 16 exit streak continues.

description: Schools and colleges across Mumbai, Thane and Palghar remained closed today after authorities declared aholiday following the India Meteorological Department's orange alert for heavy rainfall. The precautionary measure was taken to ensure student safety as heavy showers and gusty winds are forecast. While government and private offices continue to function, citizens have been advised to avoid unnecessary travel. description: Recent research has unveiled that giant ocean whirlpools, also termed mesoscale eddies, play a crucial role in transporting freshwater from the Congo River into the Atlantic Ocean. title: Where does Congo River’s huge freshwater flow go? Scientists now know
